_comment: ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection, Jwt:Key and Crypto:Key are secrets and must NOT be committed here — set them with 'dotnet user-secrets set' in Development (e.g. Server=(localdb)\MSSQLLocalDB;Database=RealtimeChatDb;Trusted_Connection=True;MultipleActiveResultSets=true), and via environment variables (ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection, Jwt__Key, Crypto__Key) in production.
